page_index.description: Zero-based physical index, distinct from the printed page label.

parent.description: The attachment, not an invented bibliographic parent.

AppId.description:
An app as the platform names it: a bundle ID on macOS, an executable name
on Windows. Never a window title or document name.

content_hash.description: Identifies the file contents without exposing a path or attachment URL.

CitationError.description:
Fixed citation diagnostics contain no source data, paths, keys or request text.
A front-end boundary maps a wholly invalid/cancelled request to its envelope error.

expected_annotation_cite.description: Captures the annotation page/parent intent separately from its cited work.

expected_cite.description:
A picked item carries its original cite fingerprint for atomic copy-time validation.
Direct requests may omit it when they intentionally use the current snapshot.

form.description: Overrides the request form, allowing mixed forms in one citation.

bibliography.description: The checked bibliography's content, without its location or text.

checked_at_ms.description: Present only for a complete successful read made by this citation call.

CitationReceipt.description: Immutable citation evidence. Historical source material is not stored here.

meaning_version.description: Citation meaning changes independently of package and wire versions.

request.description: Resolved output and ordered records, with their actual cite fingerprints.

sample.description: The visible sample marker is part of the attested content.

input_language.description: None uses en-US, never the process or operating-system locale.

items.description: Input order and duplicate references are meaningful and must be preserved.

output_locale.description: None uses the style default. Engines validate locale strings as data.

strict.description: Refuse a citation with losses, refusals or unhealthy sources.

CitationResult.description:
Results, unlike requests, accept fields they do not know, so a client keeps
working when a newer engine adds one (decision 0028).

content_hash.description: Digest of the exact clipboard representations, including their presence.

destination.description: The app this citation was made for, when a caller named one.

language.description:
The language a formatted citation is written in, whatever the interface
uses. Key syntaxes have none: the destination's processor decides.

outcomes.description: Exactly one outcome per request item, addressed by its zero-based index.

receipt.description: Evidence of the records and options actually used, not an archive.

last_successful_read_ms.description: Absent for caller-supplied snapshots, which do not establish a source read.

CitationWarningCode.description: Fixed codes only; source diagnostics never include field text or locations.

CopyReason.description: Why a citation was copied instead of pasted.

oneOf.description: An unrecognised app has no explicit paste approval.
System-wide secure typing is enabled, possibly by another app.
The final paste check was unavailable or could not finish in time.
macOS Accessibility trust is required for the identity-only focus proof.
A paste would replace selected text the search never showed.
A changed citation replaces only the old citation, selected.

Destination.description:
What Ibis does for a named app: the format the engine chose for it from
the person's settings, and whether it pastes, with pasting on and
permitted, as they are by default.

name.description: The app's name, when Ibis knows it.

writing.description: The writing that chose it, when one did.

DisplayBlock.description:
A block covers content runs in [start, end). Blocks are in opening order;
ranges are nested or disjoint, never crossing. Equal ranges retain nesting.

DisplayBlockKind.description: Passive CSL layout, independent of HTML class names or CSS.

DisplayNode.description:
One display group owns ordered text leaves and their block layout;
shared punctuation has no item.

DisplayRun.description:
Output-only passive presentation. The smaller request TextRun contract stays
independent of the additional styles a citation processor may produce.

DisplayTree.description: Ownership groups with bounded-depth passive blocks and styled text leaves.

ErrorReason.description:
Why a request failed, when the code alone cannot tell a caller what to change.
Front ends choose their words from it; they never guess a reason from the code.

oneOf.description: Strict citation policy found losses, refusals or unhealthy evidence.
No style has the requested id; `styles` lists them.
No output has the requested id; `outputs` lists them.
The requested locale is not bundled; `styles` lists the locales.
The key is repeated in a library, so every entry under it is skipped.

The entry with this key is damaged, so it is skipped; the library's
warnings say where and why.
Several references share the key.
A key output needs a citation key this reference does not have.
The selected library file was moved, renamed or removed.
The program started as the Ibis app does not exist.
The program started as the Ibis app is not Ibis.
The Ibis app started but did not confirm the request in time.
The app's library settings did not finish loading in time.
Zotero is running but does not let other applications read it.
Zotero is closed and which profile to read is not settled; name one.
A closed read is unsafe or impossible here; opening Zotero is the fix.
No Zotero library is on this computer.
A closed read needs a private copy and there is no room for it.
A CSV file's first row does not name the columns of Ibis's template.
Nothing has the key in what was read, and a library was too large to read whole.
Neither the file's name nor its contents identify a supported library format.
Two records a request sends share an `id`, `1` and `"1"` included.
A record a request sends was not valid CSL-JSON, so none is cited.

FormatFrom.description: Which level chose a citation's format (decision 0042); the engine decides.

oneOf.description: The writing chosen for this app.
The format this app was given when the person changed it there.
Your format for this kind of app.

Nothing was chosen; the format suits the kind of app. The first
paste with it says so, once.

FormattingProvenance.description: Hashes of the shipped processor and style/locale bundle used for CSL output.

GoldenCase.description: Shared fixture format, replayed by each front end as it adopts the contract.

Identifier.description: A recognized identifier in canonical form.

ItemRef.description:
Identity inside one library; citation keys are intentionally separate.
Non-item kinds use source-namespaced keys (for example `tag:...`) so
source tags and collections cannot collide with native item keys.

LibraryId.description:
A library's opaque token. It says nothing about the library: its kind and
capabilities are fields of its description, and nothing may read them from
here. Sources mint one with [`LibraryId::digest`] over a private key and the
source's identity, so a seen id confirms no guessed location.

value.description: Literal range or pinpointer, never interpreted as markup.

LocatorTerm.description:
CSL 1.0.2 input locator vocabulary, including the disambiguating `-locator` names.
https://github.com/citation-style-language/schema/blob/v1.0.2/schemas/input/csl-citation.json

item.description: Zero-based request index; None describes a request-wide loss.

text.description: Untrusted plain text; front ends must never inject this as HTML.

command.description: A command name for syntaxes that support it; engines validate its grammar.

oneOf.description:
An output by its id in the engine's `outputs` list: a key syntax or a
common style. The engine writes it as that entry's own output.

added_at.description: Source-added metadata; affects recents/display, never citation meaning.

csl.description: Normalised CSL data; all variables may affect a chosen style.

identifiers.description:
Search-only identifiers (for example arXiv eprints), never invented as
printed CSL fields. They invalidate display/search, not citation picks.

warnings.description: Item-local conversion uncertainty, independent of CSL and source paths.

Recovery.description: Exactly one next action; absence must have an explicit, machine-readable reason.

conditions.description: Source conditions are data only; this contract never executes them.

Snapshot.description:
No mutable object access is exposed. Refresh constructs a new value while
existing picker sessions retain their original value.

StrictCause.description: The fact that prevents a strict citation, retained for every client.

System.description: The operating system an app ID belongs to.

TextRun.description: Fixed-depth rich text: styling is data, never arbitrary HTML or executable markup.

WritingName.description: The writing that chose a format.

ZoteroTable.description: A fixed database identifier, never a name supplied by an untrusted source.
